about.title: About Talred Tasks
about.description: A PHP/Laravel API demo that keeps task rules in the domain, coordinates use cases in the application layer, and exposes explicit HTTP contracts.
about.architectureDescription: Each layer has a clear responsibility, and business rules stay independent of Laravel and persistence details.
about.domainDescription: Project and task aggregates, identifiers, statuses, priorities, and transition rules express the task-management language.
about.applicationDescription: Commands, queries, handlers, and use cases coordinate work through repository contracts.
about.apiDescription: Laravel controllers, validated requests, and resources define the HTTP boundary and response contracts.
about.infrastructureDescription: Eloquent repositories and mappers implement persistence behind domain-owned contracts.
about.integrationDescription: The Nuxt BFF handles browser-facing requests, while Talred Identity manages sign-in and project access.
